# xw-nukkit-plugins
Plugins for nukkit

# use/download
See the tutorials at [www.xworlds.eu/dev/nukkit](http://www.xworlds.eu/dev/nukkit) on how to install the nexus repository.
You may download the latest version from there.

# plugin overview
* [xw-nukkit-web](https://github.com/mepeisen/xw-nukkit-plugins/blob/master/xw-nukkit-web/): A web server extension that can be used to support web pages with json queries etc.
name: xw-web
